description:
Patterns is a private OCD journal and practice companion for noticing patterns, delaying compulsions, and building consistent recovery habits.

FREE TO USE

• Record urges, triggers, anxiety, and responses
• Keep a private daily journal
• Delay compulsions with guided timers
• Practice guided ERP exercises
• Complete self-checks and view basic insights
• Access coping and urgent-support tools

PATTERNS PRO - ONE-TIME PURCHASE

• Build detailed exposure hierarchies
• Organize exposure materials and practice plans
• Follow structured recovery programs
• Use action planning and implementation intentions
• Practice urge surfing, response prevention, and uncertainty
• Run behavioral experiments
• Explore recovery metrics and deeper reflections

Your journal and OCD content remain on your device. Patterns does not require an account. Optional anonymous usage analytics are disabled unless you choose to share them.

Patterns is a self-help tool and is not a replacement for professional diagnosis, therapy, or emergency care.
promotionalText: Track urges and delay compulsions for free. Unlock exposure ladders, structured practice, and recovery metrics with one purchase. No subscription, no account.
whatsNew:
Patterns 1.9 adds a full light theme. Choose System, Light, or Dark in Settings and the whole app follows, including Today, Journal, Insights, and every recovery tool.

IMPROVED

• A clearer path to Pro. Advanced tools now introduce themselves where you actually meet them, instead of interrupting you with popups.
• More reliable purchases, with better product loading, clearer restore results, and entitlement checks that run again when you reopen the app.
• Optional anonymous usage analytics now has a clearer consent choice in Privacy settings. It stays off until you turn it on, and turning it off clears pending events.

Your journal entries, exposures, compulsions, and recovery notes stay on your device.
